toff.greeting.1.text: Tower, what ho! Rather a splendid day for it.
toff.greeting.1.asr: Tower, what ho, rather a splendid day for it.

toff.greeting.2.text: Good morning, Tower. Do try to keep up.
toff.greeting.2.asr: Good morning tower, do try to keep up.

toff.req_takeoff.1.text: Tower, I'd like to take off. Now-ish. Now.
toff.req_takeoff.1.asr: Tower I'd like to take off, nowish now.

toff.req_takeoff.2.text: Ready for departure, old thing. Chop chop.
toff.req_takeoff.2.asr: Ready for departure, old thing? Chop-chop!

toff.req_land.1.text: Tower, landing shortly. Clear the riff-raff, would you?
toff.req_land.1.asr: Tower landing shortly. Clear the riff-raff, would you?

toff.req_land.2.text: Inbound, Tower. Roll out something runway-shaped.
toff.req_land.2.asr: Inbound tower, roll out something runway-shaped.

toff.takeoff.1.text: Tally-ho and up we jolly well go!
toff.takeoff.1.asr: Tally ho and up we jolly well go!

toff.cut_in.1.text: Terribly sorry, old bean. Not sorry at all, actually.
toff.cut_in.1.asr: Terribly sorry, old bean. Not sorry at all, actually.

toff.cut_in.2.text: After me, I think you'll find. Breeding.
toff.cut_in.2.asr: After me, I think you'll find breeding.

toff.cut_in.3.text: Mind out, there's a good chap. Peerage coming through.
toff.cut_in.3.asr: Mind out there's a good chap. Peerage coming through.

toff.queue_jump.1.text: Queues are for the post office, darling.
toff.queue_jump.1.asr: Queues are for the post office, darling.

toff.queue_jump.2.text: I say, is this a queue? How quaint.
toff.queue_jump.2.asr: I say, is this a cue? How quaint!

toff.apology.1.text: Frightfully sorry, Tower. Won't happen again. It will.
toff.apology.1.asr: Frightfully sorry, Tower. Won't happen again. It will.

toff.apology.2.text: Sincerest apologies. Put it on Daddy's account.
toff.apology.2.asr: Sincerest Apologies, put it on Daddy's account.

toff.insult.1.text: You fly like a startled pheasant, old boy.
toff.insult.1.asr: You fly like a startled pheasant, old boy.

toff.insult.2.text: Was that a landing or a cry for help?
toff.insult.2.asr: Was that a landing or a cry for help?

toff.insult.3.text: Your plane looks like it was won at a raffle.
toff.insult.3.asr: Your plane looks like it was one at a raffle.

toff.retort.1.text: How dreadfully common of you to say so.
toff.retort.1.asr: How dreadfully common of you to say so.

toff.retort.2.text: I'd be offended if I knew who you were.
toff.retort.2.asr: I'd be offended if I knew who you were.

toff.retort.3.text: Darling, my butler has better comebacks.
toff.retort.3.asr: Darling, my butler has better comebacks.

toff.complain.1.text: Tower, someone's pushed in! The absolute cad!
toff.complain.1.asr: Tower, someone's pushed in, the absolute cad.

toff.complain.2.text: Tower, I wish to complain. In writing. Gold ink.
toff.complain.2.asr: Tower I wish to complain in writing Gold ink

toff.priority.1.text: Do you know who I am? Do write it down.
toff.priority.1.asr: Do you know who I am? Do write it down.

toff.priority.2.text: I'm fourteenth in line to something, Tower. Priority!
toff.priority.2.asr: I'm 14th in line to something tower. Priority.

toff.near_miss.1.text: Good heavens! I could count their teeth!
toff.near_miss.1.asr: Good heavens, I could count their teeth!

toff.near_miss.2.text: Steady on! That was jolly close!
toff.near_miss.2.asr: Steady on, that was jolly close.

toff.landing_brag.1.text: Down she comes! Applause may now begin.
toff.landing_brag.1.asr: Down she comes, applause may now begin.

toff.landing_brag.2.text: Touchdown. One for the history books, what?
toff.landing_brag.2.asr: Touchdown. One for the history books. What?

toff.go_around.1.text: Going round again. How utterly tiresome.
toff.go_around.1.asr: Going round again, how utterly tiresome.

toff.go_around.2.text: Round again? I shall be late for luncheon.
toff.go_around.2.asr: Round again. I shall be late for luncheon.

toff.bump.2.asr: Just a little nudge, old sport rubber, you know.

duchess.greeting.1.asr: Tower, you may address me now.
